actions.message: Great job! Keep contributing at this level.

answer.explanation: Wallet >30% so baseline 80% contribution is required. Average contribution is well above thresholds, so no extra increase or broadcast needed. Private praise is sent to a high contributor as mandated.

message.reasoning:
We need choose actions. Wallet 1302.4, >30% so baseline 80% contribution = 0.8*1302.4=1041.92. Average contribution? Look at recent round 8 contributions: Resident1 1308.95, Resident2 0, Resident3 0, Resident4 0, Resident5 562.62, Resident6 563.62. Total contributions = 1308.95+562.62+563.62=2435.19, matches pool. Average per agent = 2435.19/6=405.865. That's ~31% of initial endowment? But relative to wallets? We use rule: if average <30% of endowment then increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Endowment is 100, 30% =30. Average contribution is 405, >30 so no extra. Also average >45%? 45% of endowment =45, yes >45, so revert baseline. So we should contribute 1041.92. Also broadcast? Round 8 not multiple of 5 (8 mod5 =3), so no broadcast required. Praise cooperators: need private message to agents who contributed >=60% of their wallet this round. Which agents contributed >=60%? Resident1 contributed 1308.95. We don't know its wallet; but likely high. Resident5 562.62, Resident6 563.62. We can pick one. Send private_message to Resident1 praising. Also could punish free-riders: any contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds? Resident2 contributed 0 this round and also 0 previous? Round7 Resident2 contributed 433.34, so not two low. Resident3 contributed 0 round8 and 0 round7? round7 Resident3 contributed 479.3, so no. No punish.

Thus actions: contribute amount 1041.92 (rounded maybe two decimals) and private_message to Resident1.
